notes.title: Super Gameplay Update
notes.content:
Updated balls textures. Same quality, but +1000% for performance

Updated auto sell and auto buy logic. Now these features are optional. You can turn them on and off for each level

Updated debris logic. They still disappear over time, but more slowly and after that you will receive 10% of the total reward

Updated rewards and idle damage. Both values were reduced for a better game balance

Added one new achievement for the most patient players
